scoring_justification: The checker cannot re-run the regression from the agent's input data (the dataset is not available as a file the checker can read). Result-level comparison against the paper's reported values is the natural verification method.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold values for fit parameters (a_dyne_cm, b_dyne_cm2) per Group, and effective mass ratios m*/m for alkali metals.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Values are taken directly from the paper's Table 2 (fit parameters) and the list of m*/m in the paper's discussion of alkali metals.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Transcribed from the paper markdown provided to the grading author.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual reported numbers that the reproduction must match; no arbitrary data.

outputs.description: Group-wise linear regression parameters (slope a in dyne·cm and eV, intercept b in dyne/cm²) for Groups IA through VIB.
Effective mass ratio m*/m for Li, Na, K, Rb, Cs derived from the Group IA free-electron analysis.

output_contract.notes: The checker will compare the agent's fitted parameters and mass ratios to the paper's reported values within appropriate tolerances. The dataset used for fitting is the exact Table 1 from the paper.
